title: From Scripts to Reliable Systems: Five Engineering Habits I Now Use
summary: A practical reflection on the engineering habits that make data and automation work easier to trust: explicit contracts, validation, visible state, failure recovery, and human review where consequences matter.
impact: Shows how I think about maintainability and trust, not only getting a script to run once.

title: AI in Education: From Sentiment to Evidence
summary: Expanded an education analysis into a multi-source study combining a 23,218-response student survey with Census, O*NET, and BLS evidence while keeping attitudes, outcomes, and causal claims separate.
impact: Demonstrates evidence-first analysis, source comparison, methodological safeguards, and explicit limits on what the data can support.

title: Building Reproducible MLB Analytics from Structured Data
summary: A compact case note on validating structured baseball data, persisting normalized records, deriving standings and player metrics, and verifying outputs with reproducible fixtures.
impact: Demonstrates a complete path from input validation through storage, derivation, testing, and visible analytical output.
